scenarios.description: LoopAgent.builder() returns a non-null Builder instance when called.
LoopAgent.builder() returns a distinct Builder instance on each call.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl returns Flowable.empty() when subAgents() returns null.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl repeats event emission up to Integer.MAX_VALUE times when maxIterations is not set.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl propagates error downstream when one of the subAgent.runAsync(invocationContext) streams emits an error.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl does not emit any events if maxIterations is set to 0.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits events and stops immediately when the first emitted event has escalate action, regardless of maxIterations.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl propagates error downstream when subAgents list contains a null element and runAsync is called.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl propagates error downstream when subAgent.runAsync(invocationContext) throws an exception on subscription.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits all events and does not stop early when none of the events have escalate action and maxIterations is set.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits all events and does not stop early when none of the events have escalate action and maxIterations is not set.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits events out of runAsyncImpl when InvocationContext is null and subAgents are present.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits events out of runAsyncImpl when InvocationContext has edge-case values and subAgents are present.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl returns a Flowable that respects the backpressure and unsubscribes early when takeUntil stops the stream.
LoopAgent.runAsyncImpl emits repeated events from subAgents when maxIterations is set to a negative value.

scenarios.description: LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) returns a Flowable that emits UnsupportedOperationException with the exact message 'runLive is not defined for LoopAgent yet.'.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) emits only a single error and does not emit any Event values.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) throws the exact type UnsupportedOperationException and does not throw any other exception type.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) does not use or depend on the passed InvocationContext argument; the result is always UnsupportedOperationException regardless of argument value.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) completes the Flowable stream after emitting the UnsupportedOperationException error.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) returns a Flowable error when called on an instance constructed with maxIterations unset (Optional.empty()).
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) returns a Flowable error when called on an instance constructed with maxIterations set to 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE, or a negative value.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) returns a Flowable error when called on an instance with no subAgents, one subAgent, or multiple subAgents.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) returns a Flowable error when called on an instance with beforeAgentCallback/afterAgentCallback lists of any size, including empty.
LoopAgent.runLiveImpl(invocationContext) does not change any LoopAgent field state or side effect after invocation.
